subject: Renewal onboarding cadence & QBR invite — Starlit AI (term + capacity)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Tom Brennan <tom.brennan@starlit.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal onboarding cadence & QBR invite — Starlit AI (term + capacity)

Tom / Aisha —

Hope you’re both well. I wanted to kick off the renewal + expansion conversation for Starlit ahead of the end-of-term later this quarter. Summary of what we want to cover in the kickoff / QBR: 

- Confirm target term options (12 vs 24 months) and preferred renewal date window
- Align on desired capacity uplift (estimated token throughput & burst profile)
- Stakeholder map for approvals (Finance / Legal / Platform / CTO)
- Mutual Action Plan (owners, due dates) and any security evidence needed for procurement

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min QBR next week to align timelines and owners
2) Share an updated Mutual Action Plan and draft amendment for review
3) Follow up with legal to surface any redlines

Please confirm: (a) who from Starlit should join (we suggest Product ops + Procurement + Engineering lead), and (b) three 30-min windows that work next week. I’ve attached an initial MAP and draft amendment for reference.

Attachments: Starlit_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (stub), Draft_Amendment_v2.pdf (stub)

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: Goals + renewal targets
- 10m: Capacity numbers & staging plan
- 10m: Timeline, owners, legal/finance asks
- 5m: Next steps & calendar hold

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Marcus Lin
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Tom Brennan <tom.brennan@starlit.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Cc: Aisha Kapoor <aisha.kapoor@starlit.ai>, legal@starlit.ai, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal onboarding cadence & QBR invite — Starlit AI (term + capacity)

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear plan.

We’re aligned to start this now. Quick answers:
- Attendees: Myself (Head of ML infra), Aisha (Procurement), Priya (Engineering lead) and I’ll loop in Finance (cc’ing legal initially is fine).
- Capacity ask: high-level target is +2x average token throughput with short bursts to 5x during peak synthetic test windows. We’ll solidify numbers once we align on staging.
- Term: prefer to evaluate both 12- and 24-month options in the QBR.

Best times for our side next week: Thu 4/15 10:00–10:30 PT, Fri 4/16 11:00–11:30 PT, or Mon 4/19 09:30–10:00 PT. Any of these work?

One ask for the meeting: can you include an internal ops/implementation contact who can speak to rollout timing (KV cache warmup, canary plan)?

Per your ops request, Soojin (cc’d) will join to review rollout timing and staging: she’ll cover KV cache warmup, batching profiles, and a suggested canary cadence. Jordan will serve as the renewal owner for contract/terms items.

Updated agenda we’ll send as a calendar attachment once time is set:
- Goals & success criteria (5m)
- Capacity uplift numbers & staging plan (10m) — Soojin
- Term options & commercial summary (8m) — Marcus/Jordan

Please review the MAP column titled "Action owner (customer)" and populate with the names for Procurement / Finance / Platform before the meeting if possible.

Subject: Re: Renewal onboarding cadence & QBR invite — Starlit AI (term + capacity)

Pinging internal notes for the renewal thread before the QBR.

Marcus / Jordan — a few internal asks so we’re prepared for the call: 
- I’ll draft a short runbook for the canary rollout (stages, monitoring thresholds, rollback conditions). Target: share runbook by EOD Fri 4/9.
- Need expected production RPS and average sequence length from Starlit to size the initial burst instances; Tom/Aisha, if you can paste a quick forecast into the MAP that will speed sizing.
- Commercial levers we can offer in the call: stepped pricing based on committed monthly tokens, a 60-day test window with limited credits for burst testing, and an optional SLO credit clause for the 24-month term. I recommend we hold on deeper discount discussion until after the first alignment call (gives us leverage on final capacity numbers).
